quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.grillguh: Hm. The Grill Guh's barbecue is still cold. Help him first, then come back. A journey begins with a burning portal, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.geen_kamp: There's no spot for my cart here, nyeg. Find me at another big Barbecue Pit: everything is ready there.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.hallo: Aha, there you are. Right on time. Sit down, you have to see this...
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.klusjes: The party won't set itself! Still to do: %s.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.klus.vuurwerk: launch a rocket (the crate on my cart)
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.klaar_voor_fee: Everything ready? Then let's party. Watch my hat.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.na_feest: You have the ring. Don't eat it, don't put it on. Talk to Sam-guh: he's coming along, whether you like it or not.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.proviand: Sam-guh is coming along, good. Pack the provisions first: the crates are by my cart.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.portaal: All packed? Then walk to the grill portal with Sam-guh. I'll switch it on as soon as you're there. Fly... no wait, that's for later.
quest.guhs.ringh1.guhdalf.ring_kwijt: Lost it? The ONE nibble? Here, I'd already found it again. In your other pocket. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.vuurwerk.klus: FWOOSH! The first rocket is up in the sky. Guhdalf nods, pleased.
quest.guhs.ringh1.vuurwerk.wacht: The next rocket needs to cool down a bit first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.vuurwerk.dak: A rocket can't go up here: there's something above the crate.
quest.guhs.ringh1.tafel.klus: You put the cake and the nibbles on the table. It looks very festive. There's a bite missing already...
quest.guhs.ringh1.tafel.kijk: The party table of the Nibble Shire. There is always cake. There is always a bite missing.
quest.guhs.ringh1.tafel.straks: No snacking yet! The party has to start first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.klusjes_klaar: Everything is ready for the party. Talk to Guhdalf!
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.onbekend: Good day to you! I'm Sam-guh, the gardener. If you're looking for Guhdalf: he's grumbling away by his cart, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.uitnodiging: A party? With cake? I'm coming, nyeg! I'll bring my own spoon.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.komt_al: I'm on my way! Just watering the potatoes.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.eerst_feest: Party first, the rest later. That's how we do things here.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.mee1: A journey with a ring that smells like nibbles? Without a cook? Not happening, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.mee2: I'm coming too! I've already strapped my pans on. But provisions first: without sausage I'm not walking past the garden gate.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.proviand.0: Sausage! That'll get you over the first hill, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.proviand.1: Cheese. A whole wheel. For when the sausage runs out. So for in a minute.
quest.guhs.ringh1.sam.proviand.2: Nibbles! Boil 'em, mash 'em, stick 'em in a stew.
quest.guhs.ringh1.proviand.kijk: A crate of provisions for the road. It smells delicious.
quest.guhs.ringh1.proviand.zonder_sam: You'll never carry this without Sam-guh. Ask him along first, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.proviand.sam_ver: Sam-guh is too far away to take it. Wait a moment until he's with you.
quest.guhs.ringh1.proviand.klaar: The backpack is full. Time to go: off to the grill portal!
quest.guhs.ringh1.portaal.sam1: This is it. If I take one more little step, I'll be farther from home than I've ever been, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.portaal.sam2: ...Oh, all right then. But if there's no second breakfast over there, I'm complaining to Guhdalf.
quest.guhs.ringh1.portaal.sam_ver: Wait for Sam-guh! You're not going through that portal without him.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.0: Good morning! Or do you mean that it is a good morning, whether I want it or not? Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.1: Adventures? Nasty, bothersome things. They make you late for dinner.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.2: Have you had second breakfast yet? And elevenses? Lunch? Afternoon tea? Nyeg, what a life.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.3: That Guhdalf. Always fireworks, always a fuss. But his cake is good.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.4: Sam-guh's potatoes are the best in the whole Shire. Don't tell him I said so.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.5: I heard that on the other side of the portal, sauce comes out of the ground. Could it be true?
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.6: My door is round. My window is round. I am round. It all fits together here, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh1.bewoner.7: If you find a ring that smells tasty: don't eat it. My granny always said that. No idea why.
gui.guhs.ringh1.doel.guhdalf: Guhdalf at the big Barbecue Pit
block.guhs.ringh1_feesttafel: Party Table of the Nibble Shire
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.uitleg: Chapter 1 of the Nibble Ring. Guhdalf has switched off the grill portal until you help him. But in the Nibble Shire nobody goes on a journey without a farewell party, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.0: Find Guhdalf. He's standing with his cart full of fireworks at the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.0: At the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension (the Super Compass points to 'My Story')
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.1: Help Guhdalf with the farewell party: launch a rocket from the crate on his cart, set the party table and invite Sam-guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.1: At Guhdalf's cart, next to the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.2: Everything is ready. Talk to Guhdalf: the party can begin, wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.2: At Guhdalf's cart, next to the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.3: You have the Nibble Ring. Don't eat it! Talk to Sam-guh: without him (and his pans) you won't get anywhere.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.3: Sam-guh is in his vegetable patch, or at Guhdalf's tent
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.4: Pack the provisions together with Sam-guh: the sausage, the cheese and the nibbles from the crates by Guhdalf's cart.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.4: At Guhdalf's cart, next to the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.5: Walk with Sam-guh to the grill portal of the Barbecue Pit. That's where the journey really begins.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.5: The Grill Coal frame of the big Barbecue Pit (or another grill portal)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.nu.klaar: The grill portal works again and Sam-guh walks with you. Off to the Guhbarbecuether: Guhvendell awaits, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.waar.klaar: At Guhdalf's cart, next to the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.0: Talk to Guhdalf at the big Barbecue Pit
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.1: Help with the party: rocket, party table, Sam-guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.2: Talk to Guhdalf: the party begins
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.3: Ask Sam-guh along on the journey
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.4: Pack the provisions: sausage, cheese, nibbles
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h1.kort.5: Walk with Sam-guh to the grill portal
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h1.regel.0: In a hole in the ground there lived a guh. Not a nasty, wet hole: it was a hill hole, and that means nibbles.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h1.regel.1: Nothing ever happens in the Nibble Shire. They eat six times a day and think adventures are a bother: they make you late for dinner.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h1.regel.2: But today a cart full of fireworks comes rattling down the path. Guhdalf the Grey is here. And he has something in his pocket that smells VERY tasty.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h1.regel.3: And so the story of the Nibble Ring begins. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.verteller: The Nibble Shire. Nothing ever happens here. And they like it that way.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.sam_laat: Mr. Guhdalf! You're late. Second breakfast is all gone, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.nooit_te_laat: A wizard is never late, Sam-guh. He arrives precisely when the nibbles are ready.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.portaal: And you wanted to go through the grill portal, didn't you? I've switched that off for a bit.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.ring: I found a ring. A nibble in the shape of a ring. Everyone who smells it wants to eat it.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.berg: It has to go to Mount Fry, in the Guhbarbecuether. And you were heading that way anyway.
scene.guhs.ringh1_aankomst.feest: But first, a farewell party. In the Nibble Shire nobody goes on a journey with an empty tummy. Will you lend a paw?
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.verteller: That evening the party is on. The whole Nibble Shire is there, because there is cake.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.sam_taart: This is the third cake, Mr. Guhdalf. The first two were for tasting, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.speech1: Dear guhs! I don't know half of you half as well as I should like.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.speech2: And the other half eats twice as much as I can bake.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.apart: Come over here. This is it: the Nibble Ring. One nibble to share them all.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.geheim: Keep it secret. Keep it whole. And whatever you do: do NOT eat it.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.omdoen: And don't put it on. Then the Eye of Sauceron will see you. He's been peckish for a very long time.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.sam_mee: A journey? Without a cook? I don't think so, nyeg. Just ask me later, I'll say yes.
scene.guhs.ringh1_feest.vuurwerk: And now: fireworks! Everybody duck, this one's new.
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h1_vu: Launch a rocket from Guhdalf's crate
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h1_fe: Celebrate the farewell party in the Nibble Shire
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h1_kl: Walk with Sam-guh to the grill portal: chapter 1 is done
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h1_be: Talk to four residents of the Nibble Shire
structure.guhs.knabbelgouw.tooltip: The Grill Guh's big Barbecue Pit with the hill holes of the Nibble Shire around it. This is where the story of the Nibble Ring begins (Guhmension)
